name: Trail of Blood
worldConcept: A desperate caravan travels a shifting frontier known as the Trail of Blood, a cursed migration route where hunger, fear, and memory shape the land itself. Travelers must ration dwindling supplies, navigate predatory nights, and confront the growing thirst that threatens to turn them into the very creatures stalking the trail. Every choice—who to trust, who to feed, who to abandon—reshapes the path ahead, carving a moral landscape where survival demands sacrifice and the frontier remembers every drop spilled.
